purpose: Proposed cohort issue backlog. Keys are training IDs, not GitHub issue numbers. Human role assignments and decisions remain to be recorded.

issues.title: [Training 00] Set up roles, GitHub, and the first real CI run
issues.body: Complete repository setup, name the BA, Developer, Tester/QA, and Technical Manager, inspect the actual CI run, confirm agent feature access, and establish Excel tracking. Record real evidence and missing dependencies. Completion: the cohort can create issues, branches, and PRs; CI results and access limits are understood.
issues.recordStatus: Proposed issue; not created or assigned

issues.title: [Training 01] Collect and approve the RQC business requirement
issues.body: Interview the assigned process owner with the Tester. Resolve the material decisions in REQ-RQC-001, draft measurable acceptance criteria, and publish the requirement with a real human approval/version when given. Completion: the agreed first task has clear behavior and a QA testability assessment. Do not invent plant rules or approval.
issues.recordStatus: Proposed issue; not created or assigned

issues.title: [Training 02] Agree a design and bounded implementation issues
issues.body: Use the approved requirement to propose the smallest implementation, record its design/limits, identify authorization/audit and consistency needs, and create linked tasks. The Technical Manager records the actual approach decision. Completion: one task meets the Ready conditions and names its dependencies and tests.
issues.recordStatus: Proposed issue; not created or assigned

issues.title: [Training 03] Design acceptance and regression tests with QA
issues.body: Draft requirement-linked test cases and synthetic data for the agreed scope, including boundary, repeated/invalid input, access, failure, and concurrency cases where relevant. Confirm business expectations with the BA. Completion: a reviewed test plan with NotRun/Blocked states; no fabricated passes.
issues.recordStatus: Proposed issue; not created or assigned

issues.title: [Training 04] Implement one ready RQC task with Copilot
issues.body: Give the Implementation Developer profile a ready task, approved requirement, accepted design, criteria/tests, and bounded scope. Inspect the diff, add relevant tests, run real checks, and open a draft PR. Completion: reviewable implementation and actual developer evidence, with remaining QA/UAT tasks visible.
issues.recordStatus: Proposed issue; not created or assigned

issues.title: [Training 05] Review, execute QA, and verify any fixes
issues.body: Review the candidate independently, execute planned QA cases, report actual defects, and verify fixes with regression evidence on the fixing commit. Keep hypothetical exercises labeled. Completion: final review/QA assessment, defect/retest links where applicable, and explicit missing checks.
issues.recordStatus: Proposed issue; not created or assigned

issues.title: [Training 06] Perform UAT and decide a training release
issues.body: The BA performs UAT on a named tested candidate; the Technical Manager assesses review, QA, open defects, and rollback evidence. Complete the release checklist and create a training release only after the actual human decision. Completion: traceable acceptance/release evidence or a clearly recorded blocking decision.
issues.recordStatus: Proposed issue; not created or assigned

issues.title: [Training 07] Evaluate AI effort and improve one skill
issues.body: Collect actual task effort across roles and quality evidence. Compare only comparable measured baselines; leave unsupported savings blank. Improve one agent instruction or skill through a reviewed PR and evaluate it on a fresh task. Completion: evidence-backed retrospective and next cohort role rotation.
issues.recordStatus: Proposed issue; not created or assigned
